## Mathematical disposition

Problem **30000114**, rank **1217**, alias **OWR-741-008**: **accepted rigorous restricted progress, Approach 1 of 5**. The unrestricted weakened Wills inequality remains unresolved by this work. This is neither a full proof nor a counterexample to the target.

For every n>=2 there is a dimension-only A_n such that every compact convex K and every primitive integer normal a satisfy

    G(K) <= V_n(K) + V_(n-1)(K)/||a||
            + A_n (floor(w_a(K))+1) sum_(i=0)^(n-2) V_i(K).

This controls each fixed bounded-lattice-width class and, by classical flatness, hollow bodies. The lattice-hull reduction also controls every lower-dimensional hull. The proof retains arbitrary translations, boundary lattice planes, lower-rank slices and the sharper surface coefficient for degenerate bodies.

Any sequence whose normalized target residual diverges must have lattice width tending to infinity. The exact unimodular shear shows that its Euclidean inradius need not diverge. The height-one-pyramid example refutes only a stronger coefficientwise Ehrhart estimate: the nonnegative surface deficit Delta(P)=V_(n-1)(P)-g_(n-1)(P) is essential, and the pyramid is not a counterexample to weakened Wills.

The remaining problem is a shape-uniform lower-Ehrhart-sum bound in each fixed dimension over full-dimensional lattice polytopes of unbounded lattice width, retaining Delta(P). The fixed-polytope asymptotics and o(surface) results do not supply it.

## Attribution and review status

The original question is Martin Henk's contribution on printed p.2089 / PDF p.23 of [Oberwolfach Report 39/2004](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/45962?nt=1). The proof uses [Henk--Wills, Corollary 4.2](https://arxiv.org/abs/0705.2088v1), Blichfeldt's bound and classical flatness, with the primary flatness input checked in [Banaszczyk--Litvak--Pajor--Szarek](https://www.math.ualberta.ca/~alexandr/papers/wwBLPS2503.pdf). The prior [Betke--Böröczky asymptotic estimates](https://doi.org/10.4153/CJM-1999-012-9) are credited with their exact scope limits.

No historical novelty or exhaustive literature coverage is claimed. The proof and independent audit are AI-assisted and unrefereed; accepted restricted progress is not external human peer review or proof-assistant certification.

## Publication boundary

Exactly seven authored-report or public-verification-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000114/`. The full mathematical proof, audit, exact formulas, accepted conclusions, precision repairs, shear warning and remaining gap are preserved. Verification/computation sections and nondistributed artifact references are removed. No omitted computation is converted into replacement prose.

The packet contains no third-party source copies, source extracts, source images, datasets, scripts, standalone computation outputs, logs or private coordination material. Public PDF hashes, sizes and bibliographic/retrieval/inspection metadata remain. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file changes, historical-accounting reset, additional proof-search approach, merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is included.

## Preparation checks

The complete frozen proof, audit and ledger were read. Their exact identities, all original manifests and the six public-source PDF identities were verified. The full proof and all mathematical audit passages were checked byte-for-byte; exact editorial differences are recorded. UTF-8/JSON, relative links, manifest, allowlist and excluded-material checks pass. A strict-whitespace clean additive replay reproduces every intended path and byte. Complete fresh base and expected ancestor trees were rehashed and independently cross-checked by Git, preserving all unrelated entries including the QUEUE blob. These are packaging checks, not a CI claim.
